answer.chip: Built for brands with many outlets

blocks.h: The problem a Mumbai brand faces
paras: A shopper in Mumbai rarely picks the first option. Nearby outlets are close together, so the choice comes down to a profile that looks complete, reviews that read well and a page that answers the question quickly.

Brands with several outlets add a second problem: listings drift apart. One has old hours, another a different phone number, a third a duplicate. The work is to make them agree and keep them that way.

leaks.note: Illustrative layout, not a client account.
leaks.lede: Each stage below is where a Mumbai buyer is lost, and the work that brings them back.

stages.breaks: Listings that drift apart across outlets.
stages.why: One wrong phone number or old hour sends a buyer to the next outlet down the road.
stages.does: We build one sheet of names, addresses, hours and categories, then claim and merge each listing.

stages.breaks: The same categories on every outlet.
stages.why: Different outlets suit different searches, and one template blurs them.
stages.does: We choose categories and services for each outlet from what it actually offers.

stages.breaks: Festival and holiday hours left unset.
stages.why: Busy seasons are when a wrong timing costs the most visits.
stages.does: We set holiday timings in advance and give each outlet a simple update routine.

stages.k: Earn a standing in a crowded area
stages.breaks: A rating that reads weaker than the next outlet.
stages.why: With many options nearby, buyers sort by rating and recent reviews.
stages.does: We set up a respectful way to ask for reviews and answer every one, with a rota for each outlet.

stages.breaks: One page for all of Mumbai.
stages.why: A page that names no area gives a buyer no reason to choose you over a nearer outlet.
stages.does: We write a page for each neighbourhood with its own details, then report by outlet.
